_why: Operator 2026-10-31 (verbatim): "validate all stuck agents and processes fix montior and make auto healings with claude code". After the 2026-10-30 disk-full the CIO wake pipeline self-deadlocked for 31 h, tradeai-cio-reactive sat 'activating' forever, zero-byte state files failed units, eight n8n breakers stayed open and the overnight LLM queue completed nothing; nothing said so. scripts/stuck_work_monitor.py reads; heals and the fixer hand-off run only when switched on below (AGENTS.md §25.10.2). Ending a process is never done here (§28.1).

locks._why: A waiter older than lock_wait_min that is in a kernel lock wait now. A pid holding and waiting the same path is a self-deadlock (code defect).

processes._why: D state past d_state_min, or a watched command past its MEASURED cap (cap_source cites the measurement; none are measured yet, so watched is empty — §28.1).

queues.name: deep_overnight_llm_queue
queues.pending_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM deep_overnight_llm_queue WHERE status = 'pending'
queues.last_done_sql: SELECT max(completed_at) FROM deep_overnight_llm_queue WHERE status = 'done'

queues.name: agent_event_queue
queues.pending_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM agent_event_queue WHERE status = 'pending'
queues.last_done_sql: SELECT max(processed_at) FROM agent_event_queue WHERE status = 'done'
queues.stuck_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM agent_event_queue WHERE status = 'processing' AND created_at < now() - interval '6 hours'

queues.name: watchlist_agent_jobs
queues.pending_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM watchlist_agent_jobs WHERE status = 'queued'
queues.last_done_sql: SELECT max(completed_at) FROM watchlist_agent_jobs WHERE status = 'completed'

heartbeats.sql: SELECT agent_id, last_seen, status, error_count FROM agent_heartbeat

lanes._why: Watched lanes page; all other ACTIVE lanes past cadence x multiplier + margin are counted in one P3 summary. Market-day-only lanes (e.g. premarket-delivery-deadman) are not watched here because they are silent every weekend by design; they carry their own dead-man.
